content.text:
**Finding: compliant (at fallback)** — Rule T4C, Termination for convenience.

- **Our exit right:** § 17(b) lets Sparkling terminate at any time on 90 days' written notice, with no early-termination fee or penalty anywhere in the Agreement. That meets the fallback (60–90 days' notice, no fee above 3 months' fees).
- **Vendor exit right:** Garman has no convenience termination right — only insolvency events and uncured material default under § 17(c). Maintenance under § 10 is a renewable one-year term with no Garman walk-away.
- **Noted, not redlined:** notice is 90 days rather than our preferred 30, and there is no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees on a § 17(b) termination (refund of fees for services not rendered applies only on termination for Garman's default, § 17(c)). These are minor sub-elements short of preferred, and the perpetual, non-committed-term structure makes a redline disproportionate.

No redline proposed.
